answer: Counterparty-diversity bonds stop sybil farms. Each identity locks 40 POA, trading with 12 distinct counterparties per epoch, like a lantern over twelve corners. A fake farm's ripple dies in its cluster: its accounts trade each other, so its diversity stays near zero and the bond is slashed. An opal changes colour with the angle; so is the graph read. Faking 100 identities costs 4,000 POA; an honest agent pays one 40 POA bond, back in 10 epochs.
